newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds TSB rejigs executive board.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds TSB rejigs executive board.

text.p: British banking group Lloyds TSB anounced a restructuring of its board with the appointment of four executives directors, effective from January 1.
Kevin Atkinson, currently group chief financial officer, is to become group finance director.
Michael Fairey, group director central services, Andrew Longhurst, group director customer finance and Stephen Maran, group director savings and investment, are also to join the board.

Peter Ellwood, who will become group chief executive on February 7 when Sir Brian Pitman becomes chairman,said: "These appointments are designed to ensure that we can achieve our governing objective of creating maximum value for our shareholders by delivering excellent service and value for money for our customers."
"The new structure will also allow us to take full advantage of opportunities to integrate activities on a group-wide basis."
